title: Karbala Akbar Mera Hai Noujawan
body:
Karbala Akbar maira hai Noujawan
Noujawan Noujawan haye Noujawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye shabhi e mustafa hai beguna
Noujawan Noujawan haye Noujawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Mout ki hichki say kah do thahar ja, thahar ja, hy thahar ja x2
Doolha Akbar ko bana lay uski Maa x2
Noujawan Noujawan Noujawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Laash Akbar ki uthaoon kis tarha, kis tarha, haye kis tarha x2
Main Zaeef hoon aur Akbar hai jawan x2
Noujawan, Noujawan haye Noujawan
<<DIVIDER>>
Ja key Dukhya say yay Keh do Aa kay Mill Aa Kay Mill Haaiy Aa kay Mill
Tairaiy Armano Ka Lutt tha Haiy Jahaañ
